name: print-social-info-session-flyer-with-3d-rocket-and-google-colours
title: Grid-paper info session flyer with a cutout speaker, 3D rocket and venue and date pills
whatItIs: A white grid-paper flyer with a Google Developer Group logo pill, 'Info Session: Breaking Into The Future Of Technology' with a blue gradient last words, a glossy 3D blue rocket, a speaker cutout in graduation robes with a name card, blue and pink pills for venue and date and multi-colour chevrons at the edges.
whatItMeans: Bright and academic; the rocket signals launching a tech career.
techniques: Use grid paper as the background.
Colour the last words in a gradient.
